body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2005') -- <Visual News> ERAE(www.erae.com) has presented its 50-inch PDP TV equipped with the scaler chip of Pixelworks company. It can express 1.07 billion colors and it features 5000:1 contrast ratio, 1000 candela brightness, and SRS WOW system. It also supports HDCP (High-Bandwidth Digital Content Protection), the international standard for image transmission technology. It is going to be released on the market later this month and will cost 4,390,000(KRW) <AVING Special Report Team for ‘KES2005’ : Editor&Publisher, Jason Lee, Joshua Shim, Nikki Whang, Sheri Choi, Sophia Kwag, Annie Park, Caleb Ma, edited by Daniel Sirh>
